name: Assembler
description: A two-axis assembler: take a lid from one belt, set it on a base on another, three times.

inputs.name: LidReady
inputs.comment: LidEye.detect: a lid waits at the lid blade

inputs.name: BaseReady
inputs.comment: BaseEye.detect: a base waits at the base blade

inputs.name: XAtMin
inputs.comment: Pick1.xAtMin: the pad is over the lid belt

inputs.name: XAtMax
inputs.comment: Pick1.xAtMax: the pad is over the base belt

inputs.name: Gripped
inputs.comment: Pick1.gripped: the pad holds a part

outputs.name: XPlus
outputs.comment: Pick1.xPlus: move the pad toward the base belt while true

outputs.name: XMinus
outputs.comment: Pick1.xMinus: move the pad toward the lid belt while true

outputs.name: YPlus
outputs.comment: Pick1.yPlus: raise the pad while true

outputs.name: YMinus
outputs.comment: Pick1.yMinus: lower the pad while true

outputs.name: HoldLid
outputs.comment: LidBlade.extend: the blade holds the lid while true

outputs.name: HoldBase
outputs.comment: BaseBlade.extend: the blade holds the base while true

outputs.name: EmitLid
outputs.comment: LidEmitter.emit: put one lid on the lid belt

outputs.name: EmitBase
outputs.comment: BaseEmitter.emit: put one base on the base belt

actions.comment: Put the first lid and the first base on their belts
Raise the pad and bring it over the lid belt
Wait for a lid and a base at their blades
Let the lid and the base come to rest
Lower the pad onto the lid
Put the next lid on its belt
Carry the lid over the base belt
Lower the lid onto the base
Vacuum off, wait for the lid to let go
Raise the pad; the base blade opens and the assembly leaves
Bring the pad back over the lid belt
Wait until the assembly has left the base blade
Keep the blade open while the assembly runs out
Close the blade and put the next base on its belt

actions.name: A_IDLE
actions.body: XPlus := FALSE; XMinus := FALSE; YPlus := FALSE; YMinus := FALSE; Grip := FALSE; RunLid := FALSE; RunBase := FALSE; RunExit := FALSE; HoldLid := FALSE; HoldBase := FALSE; EmitLid := FALSE; EmitBase := FALSE; Green := FALSE; Amber := FALSE;
